title: Saudi Legal Opportunities
sourceTitle: Saudi commercial-law employer registry: original 33 targets plus verified additions
prompt:
Search for newly posted or materially changed early-career legal opportunities at every firm in the required Riyadh target universe below, but ONLY for roles based in Riyadh or elsewhere in Saudi Arabia. Required firms: A&O Shearman; Addleshaw Goddard; Akin Gump Strauss Hauer & Feld; AS&H Clifford Chance; Baker Botts; Baker McKenzie; BCLP; Bird & Bird; Clyde & Co.; CMS; DLA Piper Legal Consultants; Eversheds Sutherland; Freshfields; Ghazzaawi Gowling WLG; Gibson, Dunn & Crutcher; Greenberg Traurig; Herbert Smith Freehills Kramer; Hogan Lovells; King & Spalding; Kirkland & Ellis; Latham & Watkins; Linklaters; Morgan Lewis; Norton Rose Fulbright; Pillsbury AlArfaj; Pinsent Masons; Quinn Emanuel Urquhart & Sullivan; Reed Smith; Simmons & Simmons; Squire Patton Boggs; Stephenson Harwood; Trowers & Hamlins; and White & Case. Use reasonable name variants and local-association names where necessary, including AS&H / Clifford Chance, BCLP / Bryan Cave Leighton Paisner, Ghazzaawi / Ghazzawi Gowling WLG, Pillsbury AlArfaj / AlAlfaj, and DLA Piper Legal Consultants. Check the firm’s official global, Middle East and Saudi/Riyadh careers pages before relying on third-party job boards. Cover training contracts, trainee solicitor roles, vacation schemes, legal internships, graduate legal programmes, paralegal/legal analyst roles with a clear lawyer-development pathway, junior associate roles, newly qualified roles, and 0–2 PQE lawyer positions. Exclude roles outside Saudi Arabia even if they are in London, Dubai, Abu Dhabi, or elsewhere in the GCC. Notify me only when there is a new opening, a reopening, a material deadline/status change, or another meaningful change since the prior check. For each item include firm, role title, Saudi location, application deadline if available, experience/PQE requirement, qualification/eligibility requirements, source link, and a short assessment of why it is relevant to an ambitious early-career path toward elite corporate/finance/fintech legal practice. Flag especially strong fits and distinguish confirmed facts from inference. If nothing new or materially changed is found, do not notify me.

Additional Saudi-employer search targets: Dentons; Ashurst Perkins Coie; HFW; Al Tamimi & Company; Khoshaim & Associates; Hammad & Al-Mehdar; Z&Co.; ZH Partners; Segal Law Firm. Search current and former names and Saudi associated employers without treating separate legal entities as one employer.
Search official Saudi programme indexes, individual programme pages, employer-linked recruitment portals and employer-authored announcements, not just global careers landing pages. Include internship/internship programme, COOP/co-op/cooperative training, graduate programme/program, trainee associate, junior lawyer, NQ, legal analyst, paralegal and Arabic equivalents. Require an actual Saudi role location; a Saudi navigation link is not evidence. Verify ambiguous associate seniority rather than assuming it is junior.
Pinsent Masons: check https://www.pinsentmasons.com/careers/early-talent/saudi-arabia and its internship-programme and co-op-training-programme child pages separately. An open internship does not make the COOP programme open. Follow the employer page to the actual application destination.
Additional first-party discovery routes: Dentons — https://careers.dentons.com/go/Opportunities-in-the-Middle-East/8796702/
Ashurst Perkins Coie — https://www.ashurstperkinscoie.com/en/careers/ ; https://fsr.cvmailuk.com/ashurstperkinscoiecareers
HFW — https://www.hfw.com/careers/vacancies/
Al Tamimi & Company — https://www.tamimi.com/careers/ ; https://www.allhires.com/tamimi/
Khoshaim & Associates — https://www.khoshaim.com/
Hammad & Al-Mehdar — https://hmco.com.sa/careers/
Z&Co. — https://zamakhchary.com/
ZH Partners — https://houranipartners.com/careers/
Segal Law Firm — https://www.segal.com.sa/en/careers ; https://www.segal.com.sa/en/careers/jobs/student-intern
Blocked sources, JavaScript-only portals, general CV forms and unreviewed sources must be disclosed as coverage limitations, not reported as no vacancies. Review the employer universe for additions, name changes, associations and Saudi departures; do not claim the target list is exhaustive. Distinguish new vacancies from evergreen recruitment routes, and preserve human review before public publication.
